scopeNote: v6 measures only the 6.2 cycle's new authoring surfaces (highlight, image/gradient fills, memo shapes, page-number control), additive over v1-v5 which remain published with their own stacks and dates. Open+render are judged in ONE gate here: the observer is the macOS Hancom Office HWP.app GUI oracle (same Hancom render engine, menu-automation transport), not the Windows COM box used for v1-v5 - a successful PDF export requires the document to open, so opened is implied by render_checked. The Windows box can re-measure as a second observer when available.
